exceptions.rationale: Upstream official postgres:19-bookworm ships /usr/local/bin/gosu compiled with Go 1.24.6. gosu executes only local privilege-drop syscalls (setuid/setgid/execve) at container entrypoint startup on the internal data_net network and never invokes Go crypto/tls, net/http, net/mail, mime, or xml packages.

Stock Debian ssl-cert package placeholder snakeoil key baked into official debian:bookworm / postgres:19-bookworm base layers; PostgreSQL runs unexposed on Docker internal:true data_net and never uses this snakeoil key for public or client TLS.

Official postgres:19-bookworm (Debian 12.15) has not yet been rebuilt upstream on Docker Hub with linux-pam 1.5.2-6+deb12u3 (CVE-2025-6020 pam_namespace symlink traversal). PostgreSQL runs unexposed on internal:true data_net using gosu (direct setuid/setgid/execve without PAM or pam_namespace) with zero interactive login sessions; remove once upstream postgres:19-bookworm ships 1.5.2-6+deb12u3.
